inputs.name: moduleRelationships.registry
inputs.description: Active revision-bound manifests and declared dependency edges; no source bytes are read.

outputs.name: moduleRelationships
outputs.description: For each active unit, pages is reverse consumer traversal until the first page on each path; layouts/components/functions/configs/services/types are forward dependencies through uncategorized support to first categorized boundaries; apis/models are full transitive forward dependencies; usedBy is reverse traversal to first categorized non-page consumers; support is uncategorized forward support. Walks are cycle-safe, deduplicated and exclude the starting unit.

errors.name: Incomplete declared graph
errors.description: Skips missing/inactive units and only uses declared edges plus inferred page-to-ancestor-layout paths. Callers must separately inspect committed sourceGraph uncertainty and include a changed page itself.
